description:
Read heartbeat transitions after the saved cursor. Persist next_cursor after processing; retries can replay.
    Poll every 30 seconds, drain pages when has_more, deduplicate event IDs. Key is subscription-specific.
    Seven-day expiry requires a fresh subscription/snapshot. deleted and monitoring_changed are terminal
    events for that target. 30 reads/subscription/minute. Evidence is self-reported, not service uptime.
name: read_liveness_events
